statement: (let w := fun (X : ℕ) => (Finset.range (2*X+1)).filter (fun n => X < n ∧ 50*n < 51*X); let N := fun (X : ℕ) => 2*X+5; let f := fun (X n : ℕ) => if n ∈ w X ∧ n.Prime then Real.log n else 0; let energy := fun (X : ℕ) => letI : NeZero (N X) := ⟨by dsimp [N]; omega⟩; ∑ k : ZMod (N X), (ZMod.stdAddChar (N:=N X) (2*k)).re * ‖ZMod.dft (fun j : ZMod (N X) => ((f X j.val:ℝ):ℂ)) k‖^2; ∀ B : ℕ, ∃ X : ℕ, B<X ∧ 0<energy X) → (∀ B : ℕ, ∃ p : ℕ, B < p ∧ p.Prime ∧ (p+2).Prime)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 指定平移的 Θ 提升 · TP-0053 · 由指定 Θ 算术测试的正能量抽取孪生素数
plain_statement.en: New route · Theta lift for a prescribed shift · TP-0053 · Extract twin primes from positive energy in the prescribed arithmetic test

brief.zh: 对同一补零序列应用带符号 Parseval；能量严格正给出两端同窗的素数。
brief.en: Apply signed Parseval to the same padded sequence. Positive energy yields two primes in the same window.
